name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=cinematic, descriptor=warp_char_to_tile). Accurately reflects the body: pan cursor to a tile then play the warp-teleport char animation onto it. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Cinematic helper that pans the camera/cursor to a target tile, then plays the warp-teleport char animation for a unit onto that same tile ("appear at target tile" semantics).
logic_summary: Compiler-emitted __CHK(0x18) stack probe, then calls fd2_pan_cursor_to_tile_animated(tile_x, tile_y) to scroll the view to the target tile, then calls fd2_animate_warp_teleport_char(char_id, tile_x, tile_y, tile_x, tile_y). Because the warp-teleport callee takes both source and destination tile coords and both are passed the same target tile, the unit simply appears at the target with no separate source pan. Void return; cdecl; single basic block, no branches.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_cinematic_warp_char_to_tile(uint32 char_id, uint32 tile_x, uint32 tile_y)

params.name: char_id
params.semantics: runtime_char_array index of the unit being warped; passed straight through as the first arg to fd2_animate_warp_teleport_char.
params.reason: Descriptive and matches usage; no address residue.

params.name: tile_x
params.semantics: Target tile X coordinate; passed to fd2_pan_cursor_to_tile_animated (as target_x) and twice to fd2_animate_warp_teleport_char (as both src and dst x).
params.reason: Descriptive and matches usage; no address residue.

params.name: tile_y
params.semantics: Target tile Y coordinate; passed to fd2_pan_cursor_to_tile_animated (as target_y) and twice to fd2_animate_warp_teleport_char (as both src and dst y).
params.reason: Descriptive and matches usage; no address residue.

notes: Source comment block (aniui.c lines 783-802) and code already accurate and ASCII; no src edit needed. Disassembly @0x33f78 confirms decomp exactly (PUSH 0x18/CALL __CHK; 2-arg pan; 5-arg warp). Ghidra plate is more verbose but consistent with the refined understanding -> left untouched.
